entry.title: New: dsh-moon-light
entry.summary: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel. Exact install spec: github:lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
